mapper.sql: f.file_id, f.file_group_id, f.original_name, f.stored_name, f.stored_path, f.thumbnail_path, f.extension, f.mime_detected, f.mime_client, f.size_bytes, f.file_hash, f.is_image_yn, f.reencoded_yn, f.virus_scan_status, f.download_count, f.sort_order, f.delete_yn, f.created_at AS created_at_view
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_file (file_id, file_group_id, original_name, stored_name, stored_path, thumbnail_path, extension, mime_detected, mime_client, size_bytes, file_hash, is_image_yn, reencoded_yn, virus_scan_status, sort_order, created_by, created_ip, updated_by, updated_ip) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{fileGroupId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{storedPath}, #{thumbnailPath}, #{extension}, #{mimeDetected}, #{mimeClient}, #{sizeBytes}, #{fileHash}, #{isImageYn}, #{reencodedYn}, #{virusScanStatus}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp})
mapper.select: SELECT , g.entity_type, g.entity_id, g.download_auth FROM tb_file f JOIN tb_file_group g ON g.file_group_id = f.file_group_id WHERE f.file_id = #{fileId} AND f.delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT FROM tb_file f WHERE f.file_group_id = #{fileGroupId} AND f.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY f.sort_order, f.created_at

SELECT , g.entity_type, g.entity_id, g.download_auth FROM tb_file f JOIN tb_file_group g ON g.file_group_id = f.file_group_id
ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.file_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_file f JOIN tb_file_group g ON g.file_group_id = f.file_group_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_file SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
UPDATE tb_file SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_id = #{fileId}

UPDATE tb_file SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_group_id = #{fileGroupId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
AND file_id NOT IN #{id}
UPDATE tb_file SET virus_scan_status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
UPDATE tb_file SET thumbnail_path = #{thumbnailPath}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
